text: ( 郑州大学第一附属医院药学部，郑州 450052)YAN Liang，ZHANG Jia － li，TIAN Xin( Department of Pharmacy， The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University，Zhengzhou 450052，China)Abstract: Nuclear receptors are important to the regulation of drug metabolism and drug － drug interactions caused by chemical drugs. The metabolic pathways of traditional Chinese medicines ( TCMs) are very similar to that of chemical drugs. Many TCMs can affect the target of action or the function of metabolic enzymes and transporters through nuclear receptors，and alter the pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics of drugs， leading to the occurrence of drug － drug interactions. This review summarized the recent findings about nuclear receptors － mediated TCM － drug interactions，hoping to provide insight into the rationality of clinical usage of TCMs.核受体是一类重要的转录因子，在个体发育、内环境稳态和体内代谢等多种生命活动中发挥调控作用，包括有孕烷 X 受体( PXR) 、雄烷受体( CAR) 以及过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体( PPARs) 等多种亚型［1］。
